raw_problem.problem_text:
$$
H ^ {0} = \frac {e B _ {z}}{m} S _ {z}.
$$

在方程 (4.161) 中给出了本征旋量 $\chi _ { a }$ 和 $\chi _ { b }$ 以及相应的能量 $E _ { a }$ 和 $E _ { b }$ 现引入一沿$x$ 方向的均匀磁场作为微扰，形式为

$$
H ^ {\prime} = \frac {e B _ {x}}{m} S _ {x}.
$$

(a) $H ^ { \prime }$ 的矩阵元，并证明它和方程 (8.74) 有相同的结构形式. $h$ 表示什么?  
(b) 利用习题 8.22(b) 的结果，用二阶微扰理论求解新的基态能量.  
(c) 利用习题 8.22(c) 的结果，用变分原理求解基态能量上限.
raw_problem.solution_text:
a) $E _ { b } > E _ { a }$ ，在 $S _ { z }$ 的表象中，

$$
\chi_ {b} = \chi_ {+} = \left( \begin{array}{c} 1 \\ 0 \end{array} \right), \quad \chi_ {a} = \chi_ {-} = \left( \begin{array}{c} 0 \\ 1 \end{array} \right);
$$

$$
E _ {a} = - \frac {e B _ {z} \hbar}{2 m}, E _ {b} = \frac {e B _ {z} \hbar}{2 m}; \quad \boldsymbol {\mathcal {H}} ^ {0} = \frac {e B _ {z} \hbar}{2 m} \left( \begin{array}{c c} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & - 1 \end{array} \right).
$$

在 $S _ { z }$ 的表象中，微扰矩阵为

$$
\mathcal {H} ^ {\prime} = \frac {e B _ {x} \hbar}{2 m} \left( \begin{array}{c c} 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{array} \right).
$$

对照上题，可 $h = \frac { e B _ { x } \hbar } { 2 m }$ 2m

(b) 由非简并徽扰理论，能量的一阶修正为零 $H ^ { \prime }$ 对角元为零)，基态能量的二阶修

$$
E _ {a} ^ {(2)} = \frac {\left| H _ {a b} ^ {\prime} \right| ^ {2}}{E _ {a} - E _ {b}} = \frac {\left[ e B _ {x} \hbar / (2 m) \right] ^ {2}}{- e B _ {z} \hbar / (2 m) - \left[ e B _ {z} \hbar / (2 m) \right]} = - \left(\frac {e \hbar}{2 m}\right) \frac {B _ {x} ^ {2}}{2 B _ {z}}.
$$

$$
E _ {\mathrm {g s}} \approx E _ {a} + E _ {a} ^ {(2)} = - \frac {e \hbar}{2 m} \left(B _ {z} + \frac {B _ {x} ^ {2}}{2 B _ {z}}\right).
$$

(c) 根据习题 8.22(c) 的结果，变分法给出(实际上是精确解)

$$
\begin{array}{l} \langle H \rangle_ {\mathrm {m i n}} = \frac {1}{2} \left[ E _ {a} + E _ {b} - \sqrt {(E _ {b} - E _ {a}) ^ {2} + 4 h ^ {2}} \right] = - \frac {1}{2} \sqrt {(E _ {b} - E _ {a}) ^ {2} + 4 h ^ {2}} \\ = - \frac {1}{2} \sqrt {\left(\frac {e B _ {z} \hbar}{m}\right) ^ {2} + 4 \left(\frac {e B _ {x} \hbar}{2 m}\right) ^ {2}} = - \frac {e \hbar}{2 m} \sqrt {B _ {z} ^ {2} + B _ {x} ^ {2}}. \\ \end{array}
$$

***习题 8.24 尽管氨原子本身的薛定涛方程无法精确求解，但存在可以精确求解的"类氯"体系.一个简单的例子①是"橡皮筋氨飞其中的库仑力被胡克定律的弹性力取代:

$$
H = - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \left(\nabla_ {1} ^ {2} + \nabla_ {2} ^ {2}\right) + \frac {1}{2} m \omega^ {2} \left(r _ {1} ^ {2} + r _ {2} ^ {2}\right) - \frac {\lambda}{4} m \omega^ {2} | \boldsymbol {r} _ {1} - \boldsymbol {r} _ {2} | ^ {2}.
$$

(a) 证明:将变量 $r _ { 1 } , r _ { 2 }$ 做如下代换

$$
\boldsymbol {u} \equiv \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left(\boldsymbol {r} _ {1} + \boldsymbol {r} _ {2}\right), \quad \boldsymbol {v} \equiv \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left(\boldsymbol {r} _ {1} - \boldsymbol {r} _ {2}\right),
$$

则系统哈密顿量变换为 个独立的三维谐振子

$$
H = \left[ - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \nabla_ {u} ^ {2} + \frac {1}{2} m \omega^ {2} u ^ {2} \right] + \left[ - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \nabla_ {v} ^ {2} + \frac {1}{2} (1 - \lambda) m \omega^ {2} v ^ {2} \right].
$$

(b) 系统基态能量精确值是多少?  
(c) 如果我们不知道精确解，可能倾向于将教材 8.2 节的方法应用于哈密顿量的原始形式(方程 (8.78)). 请照此做一下(但是不考虑屏蔽).你的结果与精确答案相比如何?答案: $\langle H \rangle = 3 \hbar \omega \left( 1 - \lambda / 4 \right)$

解答 (8) 由变换

$$
r _ {1} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} (u + v), \quad r _ {2} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} (u - v),
$$

可得

$$
\boldsymbol {r} _ {1} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} (\boldsymbol {u} + \boldsymbol {v}), \quad \boldsymbol {r} _ {2} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} (\boldsymbol {u} - \boldsymbol {v}).
$$

困此

$$
\begin{array}{l} r _ {1} ^ {2} + r _ {2} ^ {2} = \frac {1}{2} (\boldsymbol {u} + \boldsymbol {v}) ^ {2} + \frac {1}{2} (\boldsymbol {u} - \boldsymbol {v}) ^ {2} = u ^ {2} + v ^ {2}. \\ \frac {\partial}{\partial x _ {1}} = \frac {\partial u _ {x}}{\partial x _ {1}} \frac {\partial}{\partial u _ {x}} + \frac {\partial v _ {x}}{\partial x _ {1}} \frac {\partial}{\partial v _ {x}} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left(\frac {\partial}{\partial u _ {x}} + \frac {\partial}{\partial v _ {x}}\right) \\ \frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial x _ {1} ^ {2}} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left(\frac {\partial}{\partial u _ {x}} + \frac {\partial}{\partial v _ {x}}\right) \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left(\frac {\partial}{\partial u _ {x}} + \frac {\partial}{\partial v _ {x}}\right) = \frac {1}{2} \left(\frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial u _ {x} ^ {2}} + 2 \frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial u _ {x} \partial v _ {x}} + \frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial v _ {x} ^ {2}}\right) \\ \frac {\partial}{\partial x _ {2}} = \frac {\partial u _ {x}}{\partial x _ {2}} \frac {\partial}{\partial u _ {x}} + \frac {\partial v _ {x}}{\partial x _ {2}} \frac {\partial}{\partial v _ {x}} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left(\frac {\partial}{\partial u _ {x}} - \frac {\partial}{\partial v _ {x}}\right) \\ \frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial x _ {2} ^ {2}} = \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left(\frac {\partial}{\partial u _ {x}} - \frac {\partial}{\partial v _ {x}}\right) \frac {1}{\sqrt {2}} \left(\frac {\partial}{\partial u _ {x}} - \frac {\partial}{\partial v _ {x}}\right) = \frac {1}{2} \left(\frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial u _ {x} ^ {2}} - 2 \frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial u _ {x} \partial v _ {x}} + \frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial v _ {x} ^ {2}}\right) \\ \Rightarrow \frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial x _ {1} ^ {2}} + \frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial x _ {2} ^ {2}} = \frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial u _ {x} ^ {2}} + \frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial v _ {x} ^ {2}}. \\ \end{array}
$$

同样可得

$$
\frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial y _ {1} ^ {2}} + \frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial y _ {2} ^ {2}} = \frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial u _ {y} ^ {2}} + \frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial v _ {y} ^ {2}} \text {和} \frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial z _ {1} ^ {2}} + \frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial z _ {2} ^ {2}} = \frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial u _ {z} ^ {2}} + \frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial v _ {z} ^ {2}},
$$

即 $\nabla _ { 1 } ^ { 2 } + \nabla _ { 2 } ^ { 2 } = \nabla _ { u } ^ { 2 } + \nabla _ { v } ^ { 2 }$

所以

$$
\begin{array}{l} H = - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \left(\nabla_ {1} ^ {2} + \nabla_ {2} ^ {2}\right) + \frac {1}{2} m \omega^ {2} \left(r _ {1} ^ {2} + r _ {2} ^ {2}\right) - \frac {\lambda}{4} m \omega^ {2} | \boldsymbol {r} _ {1} - \boldsymbol {r} _ {2} | ^ {2} \\ = - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \left(\nabla_ {u} ^ {2} + \nabla_ {v} ^ {2}\right) + \frac {1}{2} m \omega^ {2} \left(u ^ {2} + v ^ {2}\right) - \frac {\lambda}{4} m \omega^ {2} | \sqrt {2} v | ^ {2} \\ = \left[ - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \nabla_ {u} ^ {2} + \frac {1}{2} m \omega^ {2} u ^ {2} \right] + \left[ - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \nabla_ {v} ^ {2} + \frac {1}{2} (1 - \lambda) m \omega^ {2} v ^ {2} \right]. \\ \end{array}
$$

(b) 现在哈密顿量为两个无祸舍的三维谐振子哈密顿量之和， 一个频率为 $\omega$ ，另一个频率为$\sqrt { 1 - \lambda } \omega$ .)，所以基态能量为

$$
E _ {\mathrm {g s}} = \frac {3}{2} \hbar \omega + \frac {3}{2} \hbar \omega \sqrt {1 - \lambda}.
$$

(c) 对于一维谐振子，基态波函数为

$$
\psi_ {0} (x) = \left(\frac {m \omega}{\pi \hbar}\right) ^ {\frac {1}{4}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {m \omega}{2 \hbar} x ^ {2}}.
$$

因此三维谐振子的基态波函数为

$$
\psi_ {0} \left(r\right) = \left(\frac {m \omega}{\pi \hbar}\right) ^ {\frac {3}{4}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {m \omega}{2 \hbar} r ^ {2}}.
$$

对哈密顿量

$$
H = - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \left(\nabla_ {1} ^ {2} + \nabla_ {2} ^ {2}\right) + \frac {1}{2} m \omega^ {2} \left(r _ {1} ^ {2} + r _ {2} ^ {2}\right) - \frac {\lambda}{4} m \omega^ {2} | \boldsymbol {r} _ {1} - \boldsymbol {r} _ {2} | ^ {2},
$$

如果没有最后一项微扰项，基态波函数为

$$
\psi_ {0} \left(r _ {1}, r _ {2}\right) = \left(\frac {m \omega}{\pi \hbar}\right) ^ {\frac {3}{2}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {m \omega}{2 \hbar} \left(r _ {1} ^ {2} + r _ {2} ^ {2}\right)}.
$$

我们把该被函数作为试探波函数来求哈密顿量的期望值

$$
\langle H \rangle = 2 \cdot \frac {3}{2} \hbar \omega + \langle V _ {e e} \rangle ,
$$

其中

$$
\begin{array}{l} \left\langle V _ {e e} \right\rangle = - \frac {\lambda}{4} m \omega^ {2} \left(\frac {m \omega}{\pi \hbar}\right) ^ {3} \int \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {m \omega}{\hbar} \left(r _ {1} ^ {2} + r _ {2} ^ {2}\right)} \left| \boldsymbol {r} _ {1} - \boldsymbol {r} _ {2} \right| ^ {2} \mathrm {d} ^ {3} r _ {1} \mathrm {d} ^ {3} r _ {2} \\ = - \frac {\lambda}{4} m \omega^ {2} \left(\frac {m \omega}{\pi \hbar}\right) ^ {3} \int \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {m \omega}{\hbar} \left(r _ {1} ^ {2} + r _ {2} ^ {2}\right)} \left(r _ {1} ^ {2} + r _ {2} ^ {2} - 2 \boldsymbol {r} _ {1} \cdot \boldsymbol {r} _ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} ^ {3} r _ {1} \mathrm {d} ^ {3} r _ {2}. \\ \end{array}
$$

对 $r _ { 1 } \cdot r _ { 2 }$ 的积分为零(这相当于 $x$ 对基态的积分)，对 $r _ { 1 } ^ { 2 }$ ? $r _ { 2 } ^ { 2 }$ 过两项的积分是一样的，因此

$$
\begin{array}{l} \langle V _ {e e} \rangle = - \frac {\lambda}{4} m \omega^ {2} \left(\frac {m \omega}{\pi \hbar}\right) ^ {3} \int \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {m \omega}{\hbar} \left(r _ {1} ^ {2} + r _ {2} ^ {2}\right)} \left(r _ {1} ^ {2} + r _ {2} ^ {2}\right) \mathrm {d} ^ {3} r _ {1} \mathrm {d} ^ {3} r _ {2} \\ = - 2 \frac {\lambda}{4} m \omega^ {2} \left[ \left(\frac {m \omega}{\pi \hbar}\right) ^ {\frac {3}{2}} \int \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {m \omega}{\hbar} r _ {1} ^ {2}} r _ {1} ^ {2} \mathrm {d} ^ {3} r \right] \underbrace {\left[ \left(\frac {m \omega}{\pi \hbar}\right) ^ {\frac {3}{2}} \int \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {m \omega}{\hbar} r _ {2} ^ {2}} \mathrm {d} ^ {3} r _ {2} \right]} _ {1} \\ = - 2 \cdot \frac {\lambda}{4} m \omega^ {2} \left[ 4 \pi \left(\frac {m \omega}{\pi \hbar}\right) ^ {\frac {3}{2}} \int \mathrm {e} ^ {- \frac {m \omega}{\hbar} r _ {1} ^ {2}} r _ {1} ^ {4} \mathrm {d} r _ {1} \right] \\ = - 2 \cdot \frac {\lambda}{4} m \omega^ {2} \left[ 4 \pi \left(\frac {m \omega}{\pi \hbar}\right) ^ {\frac {3}{2}} \frac {3}{2 ^ {3}} \frac {\sqrt {\pi}}{\left(\frac {m \omega}{\hbar}\right) ^ {\frac {5}{2}}} \right] = - \frac {3}{4} \lambda \hbar \omega . \\ \end{array}
$$

所以

$$
\langle H \rangle = 3 \hbar \omega - \frac {3}{4} \lambda \hbar \omega = 3 \hbar \omega \left(1 - \frac {\lambda}{4}\right).
$$

由于 $\langle H \rangle$ 的极小值是大于等于基态能量的，所以必有

$$
\langle H \rangle = 3 \hbar \omega \left(1 - \frac {\lambda}{4}\right) \geqslant E _ {\mathrm {g s}} = \frac {3}{2} \hbar \omega + \frac {3}{2} \hbar \omega \sqrt {1 - \lambda}.
$$

检验如下

$$
\begin{array}{l} 3 \hbar \omega \left(1 - \frac {\lambda}{4}\right) \geqslant \frac {3}{2} \hbar \omega + \frac {3}{2} \hbar \omega \sqrt {1 - \lambda} \Rightarrow 2 - \frac {\lambda}{2} \geqslant 1 + \sqrt {1 - \lambda} \\ \Rightarrow 1 - \frac {\lambda}{2} \geqslant \sqrt {1 - \lambda} \Rightarrow 1 - \lambda + \frac {\lambda^ {2}}{4} \geqslant 1 - \lambda . \\ \end{array}
$$

***习题 8.25 在习题 8.8 中，我们发现对处理氨原子很有效的屏蔽试探波函数(方程 ，这对氨很有效，但不足以确定负氢离子的束缚态的存在.钱德拉塞卡①使用了如下形式的试探波函数:

$$
\psi \left(\boldsymbol {r} _ {1}, \boldsymbol {r} _ {2}\right) \equiv A \left[ \psi_ {1} (r _ {1}) \psi_ {2} (r _ {2}) + \psi_ {2} (r _ {1}) \psi_ {1} (r _ {2}) \right],
$$

其中

$$
\psi_ {1} \left(r\right) \equiv \sqrt {\frac {Z _ {1} ^ {3}}{\pi a ^ {3}}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- Z _ {1} r / a} \text {和} \psi_ {2} \left(r\right) \equiv \sqrt {\frac {Z _ {2} ^ {3}}{\pi a ^ {3}}} \mathrm {e} ^ {- Z _ {2} r / a}.
$$

实际上，他允许了两个不同的屏蔽因子，这表明一个电子相对靠近原子核，另一个离原子核更远. (由于电子是全同粒子，空间波函数满足交换对称.与计算无关的自旋态明显是反对称的.)证明:通过巧妙地选择可调参数 $Z _ { 1 }$ 和 $Z _ { 2 }$ 可以得到 $\langle H \rangle$ 小于$- 1 3 . 6 \mathrm { e V }$ .

$$
\langle H \rangle = \frac {E _ {1}}{x ^ {6} + y ^ {6}} \left(- x ^ {8} + 2 x ^ {7} + \frac {1}{2} x ^ {6} y ^ {2} - \frac {1}{2} x ^ {5} y ^ {2} - \frac {1}{8} x ^ {3} y ^ {4} + \frac {1 1}{8} x y ^ {6} - \frac {1}{2} y ^ {8}\right),
$$

其中 $x \equiv Z _ { 1 } + Z _ { 2 }$ $y \equiv 2 \sqrt { Z _ { 1 } Z _ { 2 } }$ . 钱德拉塞卡取 $Z _ { 1 } = 1 . 0 3 9$ (因为该值大于 ，作为有效核电荷的解释就会出现问题，但没关系，这仍然是一个可以接受的试探波函数)和 $Z _ { 2 } = 0 . 2 8 3$ .

解答波函数归一化

$$
\begin{array}{l} 1 = \int | \psi | ^ {2} \mathrm {d} ^ {3} r _ {1} \mathrm {d} ^ {3} r _ {2} \\ = | A | ^ {2} \left[ \int \psi_ {1} ^ {2} (r _ {1}) d ^ {3} r _ {1} \int \psi_ {2} ^ {2} (r _ {2}) d ^ {3} r _ {2} + 2 \int \psi_ {1} \psi_ {2} d ^ {3} r _ {1} \int \psi_ {1} \psi_ {2} d ^ {3} r _ {2} \right. \\ \left. + \int \psi_ {2} ^ {2} \left(r _ {1}\right) d ^ {3} r _ {1} \int \psi_ {1} ^ {2} \left(r _ {2}\right) d ^ {3} r _ {2} \right] \\ = | A | ^ {2} \left(1 + 2 S ^ {2} + 1\right), \\ \end{array}
$$

其中

$$
\begin{array}{l} S \equiv \int \psi_ {1} \psi_ {2} \mathrm {d} ^ {3} r _ {1} = \left(\frac {\sqrt {\left(Z _ {1} Z _ {2}\right) ^ {3}}}{\pi a ^ {3}} \int \mathrm {e} ^ {- (Z _ {1} + Z _ {2}) r / a} 4 \pi r ^ {2} \mathrm {d} r\right) \\ = \frac {4}{a ^ {3}} \left(\frac {y}{2}\right) ^ {3} \left[ \frac {2 a ^ {3}}{\left(Z _ {1} + Z _ {2}\right) ^ {3}} \right] = \left(\frac {y}{x}\right) ^ {3}. \\ \end{array}
$$

这里 $x \equiv Z _ { 1 } + Z _ { 2 }$ ; $y \equiv 2 \sqrt { Z _ { 1 } Z _ { 2 } }$ 因此，归一化常数为

$$
A ^ {2} = \frac {1}{2 + 2 S ^ {2}}.
$$

体系的哈密顿量为

$$
H = - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \left(\nabla_ {1} ^ {2} + \nabla_ {2} ^ {2}\right) - \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}} \left(\frac {1}{r _ {1}} + \frac {1}{r _ {2}} - \frac {1}{| \boldsymbol {r} _ {1} - \boldsymbol {r} _ {2} |}\right).
$$

将它作用到波函数上，得

$$
\begin{array}{l} H \psi = A \left\{\left[ - \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{2 m} \left(\nabla_ {1} ^ {2} + \nabla_ {2} ^ {2}\right) - \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}} \left(\frac {Z _ {1}}{r _ {1}} + \frac {Z _ {2}}{r _ {2}}\right) \right] [ \psi_ {1} (r _ {1}) \psi_ {2} (r _ {2}) \right. \\ \left. \left. + \psi_ {2} \left(r _ {1}\right) \psi_ {1} \left(r _ {2}\right) \right] \right\} + A \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}} \left[ \left(\frac {Z _ {1} - 1}{r _ {1}} + \frac {Z _ {2} - 1}{r _ {2}}\right) \psi_ {1} \left(r _ {1}\right) \psi_ {2} \left(r _ {2}\right) \right. \\ \left. + \left(\frac {Z _ {2} - 1}{r _ {1}} + \frac {Z _ {1} - 1}{r _ {2}}\right) \psi_ {2} (r _ {1}) \psi_ {1} (r _ {2}) \right] + V _ {e e} \psi , \\ \end{array}
$$

其中

$$
V _ {e e} \equiv \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}} \frac {1}{\left| r _ {1} - r _ {2} \right|}.
$$

下面求哈密顿量的期望值.第一项显然为基本项，

$$
\left\langle H \right\rangle_ {1} = \left(Z _ {1} ^ {2} + Z _ {2} ^ {2}\right) E _ {1} = E _ {1} \left(x ^ {2} - y ^ {2} / 2\right).
$$

第二项

$$
\langle H \rangle_ {2} = A ^ {2} \left(\frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}}\right) \left\{\langle \psi_ {1} (r _ {1}) \psi_ {2} (r _ {2}) + \psi_ {2} (r _ {1}) \psi_ {1} (r _ {2}) | \left[ \left(\frac {Z _ {1} - 1}{r _ {1}} \right. \right. \right.
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} \left. \left. + \frac {Z _ {2} - 1}{r _ {2}}\right) \left| \psi_ {1} (r _ {1}) \psi_ {2} (r _ {2}) \right\rangle + \left(\frac {Z _ {2} - 1}{r _ {1}} + \frac {Z _ {1} - 1}{r _ {2}}\right) \left| \psi_ {2} (r _ {1}) \psi_ {1} (r _ {2}) \right\rangle \right] \\ = A ^ {2} \left(\frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}}\right) \left[ \left(Z _ {1} - 1\right) \left\langle \psi_ {1} \left(r _ {1}\right) \right| \frac {1}{r _ {1}} \left| \psi_ {1} \left(r _ {1}\right) \right\rangle + \left(Z _ {2} - 1\right) \left\langle \psi_ {2} \left(r _ {2}\right) \right| \frac {1}{r _ {2}} \left| \psi_ {2} \left(r _ {2}\right) \right\rangle \right. \\ + \left(Z _ {2} - 1\right) \left\langle \psi_ {1} \left(r _ {1}\right) \right| \frac {1}{r _ {1}} \left| \psi_ {2} \left(r _ {1}\right) \right\rangle \left\langle \psi_ {2} \left(r _ {2}\right) \right| \psi_ {1} \left(r _ {2}\right) \rangle \\ + \left(Z _ {1} -
